integrity: The finite checker exhaustively verifies stated small-field cases; the infinite families are proved algebraically, not inferred from enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The full normalizer-refined polynomial is proved for three generators; the formula for arbitrary generator rank is restricted to one-dimensional projection. The known ideal counts of Lee 2020 are not claimed as new. Independence and exhaustive historical priority are not claimed.
title: Normalizer-refined subalgebra census of free two-step Lie algebras over finite fields
